programmes.d: Lucy Alexander and Martin Roberts travel to Cornwall to see a beautiful Cornish cottage; then on to Derby to see a run down home turn into a love nest. With no price guide; a derelict 'house' in Lancashire that someone has waited 25 years to buy!
Martin & Lucy visit a terraced house in Derby, a property in Kent and a cottage in rural Devon.
Martin and Lucy visit a house in Devon with some interesting wallpaper, a marvellous flat in Kensal Green and a valuable bit of land in Kent.
Martin Roberts and Lucy Alexander view properties in Plymouth, Buckinghamshire and London.
Martin and Lucy visit a cottage in Cornwall, a two bedroomed flat in Hampshire and property in Kent.

Martin has found a property in Plymouth that's money for jam...in Kent - swirling patterns are on the walls and ceilings - is it art or artex! Finally, they won't need a bow and arrow to target the problem with a cottage in Derby.
Martin and Lucy visit properties in Kent, Essex and Markham.
Martin and Lucy view properties in North London, Folkestone and Plymouth.

Lucy and Martin see a two bedroom, mid terrace in Fenton, Stoke on Trent; in Earlsfield, South London there's a ground floor, garden flat in need of some serious redecoration work; and a mid terrace, two bedroom house in Folkestone on the Kent coast.
Martin & Lucy visit an old mill in Derby, a terraced house in Middlesex and a two story maisonette in Clydbank.
Martin & Lucy visit a bungalow in Cheshire, a semi detached house in London and a Victorian mid-terrace in Derby.
Martin and Lucy visit properties in Wales, South Hampton and East London.

Lucy Alexander and Martin Roberts travel to Wiltshire to see a four bedroom box house with lots of space to play with; Devon offers a grey 2 listed house and its pink! In Stoke-on-Trent your getting two for the price of one!
Martin and Lucy visit a plot of land in Ripon, find a problem behind a wardrobe in Kent and an old Ambulance hall in Mid Glamorgan.

Lucy Alexander and Martin Roberts go to Helston in Cornwall in search of the perfect rural retreat, then to Crystal Palace to view a two bedroom basement flat and finally they go to Bury to look at a house which may be the worst on a very nice street.
Martin Roberts and Lucy Alexander visit a two bedroom house in North London.

Lucy & Martin visit a flat in Willesden with 1930s features which overlooks Gladstone Park, a cottage in Enfield which had been in the same family since 1907 and in Plymouth, Devon a former student accommodation which needs to be returned to a good state.
Martin & Lucy visit a development in the Kyle of Lochalsh, a property with a converted stable block in Kent and a mid-terrace in Liverpool.
Martin and Lucy visit an abandoned property near Wigan, a grand semi detached house in Southampton and a three bedroom house with some odd features in Derby.
Martin & Lucy visit a three bedroom semi-detached property in Kent, a house in Cardiff and a cottage in Cornwall.
Martin Roberts and Lucy Alexander visit properties in West London, Cheshire and Kent.
